content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Residents Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the PGIMER Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download PGIMER Senior Residents Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Residents Recruitment 2026 -Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 3 for Senior Residents.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Residents Recruitment 2026 -Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: A medical qualification included in the first or second schedule or Part- II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 Must be registered with the Central/State Medical Council A postgraduate qualification of an Indian University of MS (Ophthalmology) or its equivalent degree recognized as such by Medical Council of India Experience: Candidates who have completed 3 years tenure of Senior Residency and have done M.Ch are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PGIMER Senior Residents Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Residents at PGIMER?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Senior Residents post at Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Residents recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply and also the walk-in interview date for the PGIMER Senior Residents recruitment is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for PGIMER Senior Residents posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Senior Residents posts at PGIMER is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for Senior Residents at PGIMER?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a medical qualification included in the Indian Medical Council Act, be registered with a medical council, and hold an MS (Ophthalmology) or equivalent postgraduate degree.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the walk-in interview for PGIMER Senior Residents be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Chandigarh, as PGIMER is located in Chandigarh. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the PGIMER Senior Residents walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the PGIMER Senior Residents walk-in interview. Candidates should confirm from the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the PGIMER Senior Residents walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates typically need to bring original certificates, self-attested photocopies of documents, ID proof, educational certificates, and recent passport-size photographs for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Senior Residents at PGIMER?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Residents posts at PGIMER is based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be evaluated during this interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for Senior Residents posts at PGIMER?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for age criteria and relaxations.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for Senior Residents at PGIMER?
faq.answer: The salary for Senior Residents at PGIMER will be on an Adhoc basis. Specific details regarding the remuneration will be available in the official notification.
